items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I went with a fellow by the name of William, the Columbia Band.

ctx.x: No name to it, just the?

Just Louis Demene and Eddie Jackson. That's the role. So I went on to playing with them. So after I left them, I went with a fellow by the name of William, the Columbia Band. See, and after I left the Columbia Band, and I went on, I went to the Camellia Band. Well, the Camellia had a pretty good pull around this town here. They had work in the countries and down Violet and all those different places, Bertrandville. They was doing pretty good work.
